 7 hours ago Liverpool FC’s fixtures at Anfield and St Helens Stadium today will both go ahead as planned.
 By Liverpool FC
 Previous Next The men’s team host Brighton & Hove Albion in the Premier League and the women’s team are facing London City Lionesses in the Barclays Women’s Super League, with each kicking off at 2pm GMT.
 Due to the very windy weather, please take care if you are travelling to either game, plan your journey in advance and give yourself extra time.
 Club stewards will be on hand at both stadiums to assist supporters – please follow their guidance when you arrive.
 We wish you safe travels and we look forward to welcoming you to Anfield and St Helens Stadium.
